thesis: LLY는 v3.3에서 Compounder 조건과 Hard Veto 9개를 모두 통과했다. 제품력·구조적 리더십·재투자 여력은 강하고 현재가는 locked Base 아래다. 그러나 EV 56.75와 AS 61.75가 낮고, Mounjaro/Zepbound 집중도 약 64.7%, Q2 realized price -13%, acquired IPR&D/M&A를 포함한 owner cash 정규화 불확실성이 남는다. 따라서 IC는 NORMAL 2-4%를 그대로 승인하지 않고 STARTER 1-2%로 낮추며 macro pacing 0.5x로 분할 집행한다.

evidence.claim: Aggregate score is 76.66 with 100% core coverage; Compounder is the only eligible archetype and deterministic fit score is 82.875.
ED/RT review leaves all nine Hard Vetoes cleared, with no confirmed, unresolved or pending veto.
Locked valuation is Bear $345.26, Base $1,282.74 and Bull $2,016.84 versus frozen price $1,164.89; price/Base is 0.9081x.
Q2 revenue rose 48% with 60% volume growth; gross margin was 85.8%. These support strong product economics despite lower realized pricing.
Mounjaro and Zepbound generated $14.871B, about 64.7% of Q2 revenue, while realized prices fell 13%, creating a common-factor franchise and reimbursement risk.
Mechanical pre-IC state is NORMAL_CANDIDATE with a 2-4% band, while the fresh macro overlay applies a 0.5x purchase-pacing multiplier without changing the fundamental score.

counterevidence: Current price is below locked Base, so valuation is not outright expensive under the frozen assumptions.
Orforglipron approval and positive retatrutide Phase 3 results reduce long-run dependence on existing tirzepatide brands.
TTM operating cash generation is very strong and share count is declining rather than diluting.
Management has been repurchasing shares at an estimated average price materially below frozen Base value.
unknowns: Normalized maintenance versus growth capex after the current manufacturing buildout.
Full-cycle economic returns on 2025-26 acquired IPR&D and acquisitions.
Long-run realized net-price/rebate trajectory for metabolic medicines.
Commercial cannibalization versus market expansion among tirzepatide, orforglipron and retatrutide.
A clean issuer-reported incremental ROIC series.
falsifiers: Owner FCF/share fails to progress toward the locked Base path as new manufacturing capacity matures.
Metabolic volume growth slows while realized pricing pressure persists and successor products fail to diversify franchise economics.
Acquired IPR&D/M&A spending continues rising without corresponding approvals, earnings or asset value creation.

key_kpis.name: Owner FCF/share incl. external R&D normalization
key_kpis.threshold: progress toward the locked Base path after recurring pharma reinvestment

key_kpis.name: Volume / realized price / gross margin
key_kpis.threshold: volume and mix offset pricing pressure without structural margin deterioration

key_kpis.name: Franchise concentration / successor contribution
key_kpis.threshold: orforglipron, retatrutide and non-metabolic franchises reduce dependence on Mounjaro/Zepbound

next_checks: Q3 2026 pricing, volume and owner-cash conversion.
Orforglipron commercial ramp and retatrutide regulatory progress.
Acquired IPR&D/M&A milestones, capacity utilization and debt trajectory.

plain_language.business: Eli Lilly는 당뇨병·비만, 암, 면역질환 등 치료제를 개발·생산·판매하는 글로벌 제약회사다. 현재 성장의 중심은 Mounjaro와 Zepbound를 포함한 대사질환 치료제다.
plain_language.opportunity: 비만·당뇨 치료 시장이 빠르게 커지고 있고, orforglipron과 retatrutide 같은 후속 제품이 성공하면 현재의 tirzepatide 중심 성장을 더 오래 이어갈 수 있다. 대규모 생산설비 투자도 수요를 매출로 전환할 여력을 높일 수 있다.
plain_language.risk: 현재 매출이 대사질환 제품에 매우 집중돼 있고 실제 판매가격은 하락 중이다. 경쟁, 보험급여와 정부 가격정책, 파이프라인 실패, 대규모 설비·인수 투자 수익률 부진이 겹치면 주당 현금흐름과 가치가 크게 낮아질 수 있다.
plain_language.decision_reason: Compounder 조건과 모든 Hard Veto는 통과했지만 현재 가격의 안전마진은 크지 않고 하방 시나리오가 넓다. 그래서 2~4% 정상 비중 대신 1~2% Starter로 시작하고, 현재 거시환경에서는 평소보다 느리게 분할 집행한다.
